[quote=gythena;60573119][b]Continued unrest in Gythena[/b]
[spoiler=sorry it took so long lol]
The first sparks of the governments collapse were now crackling in pinewood. Two naval marine vessels joined a takeover of the Maarja Isles via a coup of the government within the capital city of Eluoja. The rebels at Ivon were kicking the Gythenan army out of the city with a quite impressive haste. There was no denying it now, the old republic would not be able to handle the weight of revolution.

And in the city of Polijamsa, things were finally boiling over. A group of young men had begun to rally against the government in the streets. As the day went on, word spread like leaves on a fall day about the matter, and numerous people were joining in the protests now. As a mob began swelling in size, movement was made towards the building housing the citys government, and, unbeknownst to them, the diplomatic envoys from Sanguivallis.

As the Sanguinians began collecting info on the current revolutionary movement, Mr. Niskala, who now was feeling a sense of false calm, continued on with his conversation. Perhaps he could convince the Sanguinians to, maybe, look past ideological differences and help a fellow nation in need. Or, simply, do not bother with the civil conflict and continue with things as normal. He was very wrong.

As Mr. Niskala continued on, discussing foreign affairs and trade, the crowd loomed closer in, up the streets and around the blocs. The crowd carried weapons, some owned with them a rifle, others simply brought rakes and axes.

Within the parliament building, things were tense but calm. Well, I do believe I could interest you in, perhaps, pinewood from Laskiiland, up north? They have amazing views up th-

The looming presence of a mob finally makes its presence known. Mr. Niskala and the Sanguinians both heard noises from outside, however they were indistinguishable for a few minutes. By the time they could tell what it was, it was far too late. The mob had arrived, and they were breaking through the locked door.
[/spoiler]
[nation]Democratic Sanguivallis[/nation][/quote]
[b]The flight from reason[/b]

[spoiler]MROS Dynamics had 3,000 men inside and all around Polijamsa. In militaryspeak, this was equivalent to maybe three infantry battalions, though as a private military company, they didn't use such complicated terminology. Instead, these 3,000 men were divided up into twelve, company-sized "teams" of around 250 men each, each team named after the callsigns of their respective operations managers or commanders. At this very moment, there were four teams actively observing the situation in the city: Team Lighthouse, which was with Don Cirino pretending to be an official security detail; and Teams Marathon, Polka, and Hotshot, which were in plainclothes pretending to be protesters in the grounds of Polijamsa Palace.

The objectives of the teams were simple. Team Lighthouse, which had been allowed inside the Palace, was to wait until the time was right to swoop in and rapidly overwhelm Gythena's ill-equipped, ill-prepared palace guards. Team Polka was to be at the very front of the palace gates, talking in the Gythenan language, observing the behavior of the rioters, noting down any visible leaders and riot coordinators, and determining their overall strength versus government forces. Team Marathon was to stock up on food and drinks and to collect any free provisions that protest leaders might be handing out and relocating these back to the hotels as extra rations for the "long haul", while Team Hotshot was to do the same but with medical supplies.

As the sounds of the emerging crowd grew louder in the ears of the palace officials, Ulf de Mayne walked away from Niskala and Don Cirino for a moment to speak with his team.

[list]

"Polka-6, this is Lighthouse-6, send message over." Ulf said into the radio, speaking quietly to avoid alerting Mr. Niskala.

"Things getting bad at the front, rioteers look like they're ready to break into Fortress, requesting permission to intervene, over." Polka-6 replied, his voice in the middle way between agitated and excited.

"It ain't looking pretty at Fortress either. If imminent, intervene immediately, over."

"Roger that, Lighthouse-6. Cool alliteration. We'll do what we can, out."

[/list]

Ulf then turned to Don Cirino, who was awkwardly trading glances back and forth with him and then Mr. Niskala, like he was tracking the ball at a tennis match. Events were proceeding faster than MROS Dynamics had anticipated. So fast, that it seems drastic action needed to be done here and now. Don Cirino stared at Ulf one last time, and after a tense few seconds, he gave a slight nod.

[i]"Lascialo sognare."[/i] Don Cirino said, and in a split second, one of the MROS contractors walked up from behind, knocking Niskala out cold with a swift strike of his rifle stock. The thud causes Don Cirino to momentarily jump. [i]Maledizione...[/i] what now, Mr. de Mayne?"

"It won't be pretty, Don." Ulf remarked, watching as MROS dragged Niskala away from the center of the room where he was out of the way. "We have a couple thousand rioters looking prepped to storm the palace. At worst, they'll burn this whole place down and then wonder why government services stopped working, at best we'll have a couple hundred new recruits to coordinate the interests of Mr. Almstedt and Mr. Cui. At the moment, we're looking at a worse case at the moment."

"That's not great." Don Cirino lamented.

"Find meaning in the suffering. We can't expect all revolutions to go the way of Sanguivallis. For now, let's do what we can to accelerate the interests of my employers."

With Niskala out of the way, Team Lighthouse began rapidly securing Polijamsa Palace, with MROS troops sweeping through each room and taking down security personnel as necessary, ordering those unsympathetic to the revolution to forfeit their arms and leave, while letting those with grievances to receive temporary employment in MROS Dynamics. At the same time, on the grounds of the Palace, Team Polka walked to the very forefront of the riots and, with the help of their heavy equipment, would break down the gates of the palace for the rioters, portraying themselves to be protest leaders.

The goal of this sudden seizure was simple. Let the people break into the palace, which will lead to a collapse in central authority. Out of that chaos, Team Polka and Team Lighthouse were to position themselves as the sole bearers of organized power, and were to coordinate with the senior-most protest leaders to decide on the course of action for the revolutionary municipal government. However, this was just a cover. Their final objective was not a simple revolution, but the full turn of Gythena towards communism, as per the orders of the Socialist International that had authorized the Sanguinians' trip.

This is where the other teams came in. Team Hotshot and Team Marathon would suspend their collection of supplies and began "collecting" protesters eager to take the revolution in a more radical direction. Hotshot-6, one of the commanders for the operation, was tasked with heading to the University of Polijamsa to find and arm any students and faculty able and willing to act as foot soldiers and theoreticians for a new revolutionary government, while Team Marathon focused on recruiting protesters from the crumbling Gythenan Army, local police forces, and the rioters themselves. Together, whatever they manage to recruit are to become the actual "intended" revolutionary vanguard, though MROS Dynamics would be sure to conceal these intents for now.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[u][b]Hydronias move - July 7th 2026[/b][/u]]

The sudden outburst of Hostilities in Tallisland would catch the attention of President Bozkhan, but it would not surprise him. The situation in Tallisland had been going downhill recently, with the theocracy seizing more and more power over the country. The banning of socialist parties would simply be the last straw in the brittle haystack.

Hydronia would express its condemnations of the move just before hostilities broke out. Nothing out of the ordinary here when it came to dealing with civil war. What t he Hydronian government would find disturbing was the Neue Republik and Thývens increasing tensions in Tallislandic waters. Additionally, as the USO arrived, things would begin to look very dark for the security of the white strait and the people of Tallisland.

Hydronia knew that this war would be a decisive moment in history, especially noting Tallislands status as a THEP partner (currently suspended in account of corruption and authoritarianism) and the extremely close proximity of Tallisland to one of Hydronias most valuable allies, the commonwealth of Bob, meaning that Hydronia couldnt just watch from the sidelines and allow the EDU to gatekeep an entire continent from the world. A plan would formulate to provide aid to the Tallislandic people and calm this civil war, whilst also allowing Hydronia to covertly intervene and express their support for the socialists in the anti-principalist movement.

The plan would begin by deploying A small naval task force to the Bobians. This task force would dock in Hydronias military base on the Bobian island, ready to launched to Tallisland if things got rough. To avoid provoking the Neue Republik, this task force would require direct permission from Hydronian military command to leave the naval base.

The next step would be carried out in the air. Recognising Tallislandd urgent need of humanitarian aid, Hydronian transport aircraft would take to the skies, carrying hundreds upon hundreds of crates, filled to the brim with basic food supplies and medicines. No matter their political affiliation or ethnicity, the people of Tallisland were at the end of the day, still people. And people deserve to have unrestricted access to human needs and human rights. Unfortunately, this is not always possible, but Hydronia can still try.

Upon arriving outside of Tallislandic airspace, the transport aircraft would send requests via radio to airport controllers across the western coast and island of the country, requesting permission to enter Tallislandic airspace on a humanitarian mission. If accepted, the transporters would begin rounds above major settlements, controlled by the government and opposition alike, dropping the aid crates by parachute.

However, there would of course be a twist. Whilst the crates flying into government-controlled territory would only contain humanitarian aid as stated, the crates that made their way into opposition territory would have hidden arms, ammunition and funds hidden in the bottom of the crates, in a compartment hidden between the actual bottom of the crate and a fake floor placed on top of the supplies. If the socialists were smart, they would find the supplies easily, signalling to them that Hydronia is ready and waiting to help.

As a testament of good will to the EDU, Hydronia would also launch several aid crates of the variety that only contained aid into the sea close to Republik ships. They would float on the surface of the water with help from buoyancy aids, which would also allow the Republik to easily acquire and inspect the crates. Additionally, Hydronia would publicly encourage other THEP members and partners to engage in the humanitarian efforts, whilst also accepting the bobians invite to deescalation talks.
[/spoiler]
